title: cosim_vehicle_mapping
description: CarMaker ↔ SUMO co-simulation mapping. Keep this file as a sibling of cosim_vehicle_mapping.json (same CoSim/ folder) so editors resolve $schema for hover and validation.

$schema.description: Pointer to this schema file, usually the sibling name cosim_vehicle_mapping.schema.json.

cosim_enable.description: Master switch. false = skip SUMO and RT bridge bring-up (CarMaker-only).

sumo_sumocfg_path.description: Absolute or project path to the .sumocfg used for in-process TraCI (office). Prefer forward slashes.

sumo_home.description: Optional SUMO install root for Cosim_bridge spawn mode (resolves to <sumo_home>/bin/sumo.exe). Empty/omitted → env SUMO_HOME or PATH. Not used by office in-process libsumo TraCI.

sumo_substeps.description: Number of CarMaker cycles between TraCI / SUMO_do_step calls.

sumo_step_length_s.description: SUMO simulation seconds advanced per TraCI step (--step-length).

sumo_gui.description: If true, in-process init prefers sumo-gui; otherwise headless sumo.

SUMO_lights.description: When true, map / write vehicle lights between SUMO and CarMaker traffic DVAs.

cosim_advance_sync.description: A★→B Hermite / predictive sync (office + RT host when enabled). Wizard default true (BR692 mapping).

cosim_ego_predict_horizon_s.description: Look-ahead horizon [s] for ego prediction when cosim_advance_sync is true. 0 uses sumo_step_length_s.

coordinate_alignment.description: Rigid transform SUMO ↔ CarMaker Fr0. Tune with Coordinate_Alignment_Wizard.py.

roi.description: Region of interest around ego in Fr0. Use a number (radius m), null/none, or { radius_m } / { radius }.

rt_host_rx_enable.description: HIL: receive traffic UDP from the host (native_cosim). On office builds this is forced off in favour of local TraCI.

rt_host_rx_port.description: UDP port on the RT for traffic frames from the host.

rt_host_rx_timeout_s.description: Seconds without traffic packets before slots are hidden / timeout policy applies.

rt_ego_tx_enable.description: HIL: send ego (and actors) UDP to the host bridge.

rt_ego_tx_ip.description: Host IP address for ego UDP from the RT.

rt_ego_tx_port.description: Host UDP port that receives ego frames.

rt_ego_tx_decimation.description: Send ego UDP every N CarMaker cycles.

rt_actor_tx_decimation.description: Send actor UDP every N CarMaker cycles.

rt_target_ip.description: Host → RT traffic UDP destination IP (native_cosim).

rt_traffic_tx_ip.description: Alias of rt_target_ip for traffic TX destination.

rt_traffic_tx_hz.description: Optional cap for between-step traffic UDP rate on the host.

traci_host.description: TraCI host for native_cosim attach mode (default localhost).

actor_enabled.description: Enable Roleplay / non-pool actor mirroring into SUMO.

actor_instances.description: Optional actor list discovered from the TestRun.

free_motion.description: Whether the CM object is free-motion.

vehicles.description: Vehicle catalogue (ego, actors, templates) used by the orchestrator and length setup.

role.description: Role such as ego or actor.

ipg_name.description: Optional CarMaker name for non-ego entries.

traffic_slots.description: Pool slots that receive SUMO flow vehicles. ipg_name must match TestRun Traffic objects.

expected_vtype_id.description: SUMO vType expected for this slot (empty = wildcard).

length_m.description: Length [m] for this slot's rear→front conversion.

flow_prefixes.description: SUMO vehicle id prefixes assigned to the IPG traffic pool (e.g. flow0.).

vtype_slot_indices.description: Map of SUMO vType id → array of traffic slot indices.

vtype_slots.description: Optional map of vType id → traffic slot name lists.

template_to_vtype.description: Optional map IPG template → SUMO vType id.

ego_template.description: Informational ego template / vehicle path from the orchestrator.
